Risk: Training instability and performance degradation due to mis-tuned optimisation hyperparameters in deep learning
Problem analysis: Manual learning-rate tuning leaving degrees of freedom in optimisation
Theoretical insight: Explicit architectural sensitivity information can set optimal update scales
Design rationale: First-order optimiser using architecture-derived per-parameter learning rates to remove hyperparameters
Implementation mechanism: Automatic Gradient Descent algorithm with complexity comparable to SGD
Validation evidence: Empirical results showing AGD matches tuned Adam/SGD across datasets without hyperparameters
Intervention: Adopt Automatic Gradient Descent during model training to eliminate learning-rate hyperparameters
Source: https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/Lia5RfipxFr2chrD3/architecture-aware-optimisation-train-imagenet-and-more
